indicators.title: FOMC rate decision
indicators.why: The single most-watched policy event on the calendar: market-implied probability of each decision bucket (cut, hold, hike) at the next scheduled FOMC meeting, from the exchange's highest-volume Fed series.
indicators.source: Kalshi public API v2 — series KXFEDDECISION
indicators.note: Buckets are mutually exclusive and use Kalshi's own wording; "Hike 0bps" means no change to the target range.

indicators.title: Fed funds rate level
indicators.why: The market's full policy-rate distribution: threshold probabilities for the funds-rate setting after the next FOMC meeting, complementing the decision buckets with the level the market actually prices.
indicators.source: Kalshi public API v2 — series KXFED
indicators.note: Each strike is the probability that the funds rate is at or above that level after the meeting; strikes are not mutually exclusive.
indicators.event_title: Fed funds rate after Oct 2026 meeting?

horizons.label: Fed funds rate after Oct 2026 meeting?

indicators.title: CPI inflation (YoY)
indicators.why: Real-time inflation expectations between quarterly heat-map updates: the odds the headline CPI print clears each year-over-year threshold.
indicators.source: Kalshi public API v2 — series KXCPIYOY
indicators.note: Strikes are probabilities that YoY CPI prints above each threshold. The exchange sometimes lists a MoM market without the matching YoY market for a given print; those gaps are marked, never interpolated. No market was listed for the October 2026 print as of 2026-10-18 — the nearest listed market closes 2026-12-10. Gaps are marked, not interpolated.

indicators.title: GDP growth (quarterly)
indicators.why: Growth-nowcast risk priced ahead of the release: odds that real GDP growth for the current quarter clears each threshold.
indicators.source: Kalshi public API v2 — series KXGDP
indicators.note: Strikes are probabilities that quarterly real GDP growth prints above each threshold; strikes are not mutually exclusive.
indicators.event_title: US real GDP growth in Q3 2026?

horizons.label: US real GDP growth in Q3 2026?

indicators.title: Unemployment rate
indicators.why: Labor-market slack as a priced probability: odds that the headline unemployment rate clears each threshold at the next monthly print.
indicators.source: Kalshi public API v2 — series KXU3
indicators.note: Strikes are probabilities that the U-3 unemployment rate prints above each threshold; strikes are not mutually exclusive.

indicators.title: NBER recession
indicators.why: The clearest market summary of macro tail risk: the probability that a recession is underway within each calendar year, per the NBER business-cycle dating the contracts settle on.
indicators.source: Kalshi public API v2 — series KXRECSSNBER
indicators.note: Annual ladder: every open calendar-year market is charted. Trading runs into the following January while NBER dating catches up.
